en: Given a string s, reverse the order of characters in each word within a sentence while still preserving whitespace and initial word order.
examples:
Input: s = "Let's take LeetCode contest"
Output: "s'teL ekat edoCteeL tsetnoc"
constraints: s does not contain any leading or trailing spaces.
There is at least one word in s.
All the words in s are separated by a single space.
title: Reverse Words in a String III
